research_question: Can a succinct linear transition structure generate an exact bounded cancellation-test representation without tabulating all words, and does that operation match a previously unread external problem's available input?

selected_external_family.title: Uniform black-box noncommutative identity testing across characteristics
selected_external_family.selection_rule: Targeted title-level selection for succinct cancellation/identity testing after inspecting only the existing metadata inventory; take the first listed manuscript in family116.
selected_external_family.prior_exposure: At freeze, the coordinator has read only family metadata and catalogue titles for116, not its source, proof, scope document or theorem statements. Existing corpus-level README/history metadata remain previously inspected.
selected_external_family.limits: One targeted external source, not a representative sample, model-training holdout, capability experiment, historical novelty test or headline certification. Prior model knowledge cannot be excluded. Record any accidental proof exposure.

fixed_candidate_operation.input: Exact field K; alphabet size n; succinct matrices describing either a fixed-length layered noncommutative branching program or a finite linear representation lambda A_w gamma.
fixed_candidate_operation.construction: Generate reachable row-space bases by incremental exact span closure, retaining a word for each accepted basis row and local closure coefficients. Do not expand every word into a feature table.
fixed_candidate_operation.outputs: A directly verified nonzero word/coefficient or a finite invariant-span/closure certificate proving every permitted coefficient zero. State width, length, field and bit-cost assumptions.
baselines: Full explicit word expansion only for finite verification controls
fixed_candidate_operation.not_claimed: A new general linear-algebra algorithm or conversion of an arbitrary black-box formula into a supplied white-box transition representation.

source_exposure_order: Save and publish this protocol before fetching the selected manuscript or scope contents.
Inspect theorem statements and available-input contract; record exact paths/blobs/line ranges.
Develop the fixed operation independently and record its success/failure against the statement-level input contract.
Only after that comparison is saved, inspect relevant source proofs/dependencies and adjudicate the transfer.

acceptance.mathematics: Complete field-sensitive proof, exact positive/negative certificates, polynomial representation-size bound where claimed, and independent mathematical plus adversarial review.
acceptance.transfer: Count a match only if the external problem supplies or legitimately yields the required representation with its promised resources; distinguish a local compatible lemma from the full headline.
acceptance.failure: A white-box/black-box, coefficient/field, uniformity, size or oracle mismatch is a recorded failed transfer, not repaired by silently changing the target.
acceptance.novelty: Compare primary weighted-automata and noncommutative PIT sources; classify known tools honestly.

computation_controls: Zero polynomial with canceling path contributions
A succinct exponential-word family without explicit expansion
notification_scope: Substantive research results only; no external correspondence or publication beyond routine authorized repository checkpoints.
